record_title: Exact weight-three 2-cover-free families are maximum triple packings
provenance: Exact extremal theorem for 3-uniform 2-cover-free families, identifying the optimum with the classical 2-(v,3,1) packing number from v=6 onward and proving extremal linearity from v=7 onward.
limitations: Specific to 3-uniform families and two covering blocks. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; full text of two relevant later papers was not fully inspected, and an equivalent short argument may exist under different extremal-set, superimposed-code, or packing terminology.
